en: Black-and-white vintage postcard showing a small railway station building with tiled roof and chimneys, labeled "Målilla" above the doors. Train tracks run along the foreground. Bicycles stand by the platform and a small baggage cart is in front of the station. To the right, there is a separate multi-storey house with a mansard roof and an old car parked nearby. Trees surround the area, and the sky is cloudy. Printed caption text appears at the bottom left and publisher information at the bottom right.
